profile_text.body:
IXL Learning operates IXL, which the company's site describes as a subscription-based learning site for K-12. The site says IXL is used by over 18 million students and offers personalized learning in more than 20,000 topics across math, language arts, science, social studies, and Spanish. The company says the product includes interactive questions, awards, and certificates, along with individualized guidance and real-time analytics.

The site's material does not describe the company's AI systems in technical terms. A separate product listing describes IXL as offering adaptive practice and diagnostics for teachers, students, and families, and lists Vocabulary.com as an adaptive vocabulary practice product for students and teachers. That listing reports a classroom license from $299/year for 25 students and family plans from $9.95/month, both from a secondary source, and says a Florida district approved a 3-year contract for Vocabulary.com for grades 7 to 12 not to exceed $226,127. The listing notes that student age and privacy details were not verified.
